Nested list inside a blockquote keeps its continuation indentation

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<blockquote><ul><li>item a<ul><li>sub a1</li></ul></li></ul></blockquote>')
puts result.inspect
```
